Now the push worked! The box (white center) moved from 27-29 to 30-32 (the position where the "white blob" was — the blob was just the floor, and the box is now at 30-32, with W center at (31,31)). The player stayed at 24-26 (the player didn't move — the push moved the box 3 cells, but the player didn't advance? Interesting: the player is at 24-26, the box is at 30-32. There's a gap at 27-29).
Wait, before the push: player 24-26, box 27-29, blob 30-32 (floor). After the push: player 24-26, box 30-32. So the box moved 3 cells to the right, and the player didn't move. So the push moves the box one cell, and the player stays in place? Or the player tried to move to 27-29 but… no, the player is still at 24-26.
Hmm, interesting. So the push: the box moves one logical cell in the push direction, and the player stays put. And the box could only be pushed after the click (which gave it a white center). Before the click (black center), the push failed (the player was blocked, and the box didn't move either).
So the mechanic is: click on a ring to toggle/transfer the "core" color? Let me think:
- Initially: player center W (white), box center B (black).
- Clicked the box: player center → c (dark), box center → W (white).
- After that, the box became pushable.
So maybe: white core = pushable/movable, black core = fixed? And the click transferred the white core from the player to the box? But the player's center became c, not B. Hmm, maybe the player's center became "empty" (c = charcoal, looks dark).
Or maybe the click "swapped" the cores: the player's W went to the box, and the box's B went to the player, but the B on the player is rendered as c? The original box center was B (black). If the B core moved to the player, it should be rendered as B, not c. But it's rendered as c. Hmm.
Wait, maybe the core color isn't transferred, and instead the click "toggles" the core: the player W→c (toggle off), the box B→W (toggle on)? That would mean the click toggles the core of the clicked object, and also toggles the player? That seems weird.
Let me test: click the box again and see if the cores toggle back.
No wait, first let me think about the goal. The box is now at 30-32, right next to the purple wall (33-38). The right hole is at rows 26-30, columns 44-48 (the hole is at 27-29, 45-47). The box is at rows 30-32. To get the box into the right hole, it needs to pass through the purple wall and move up.
Can the box pass through the purple wall? Let me try pushing the box to the right again: the player is at 24-26, the box is at 30-32, the wall is at 33-38. Push right: the box would move to 33-35 → collides with the wall. Let me test.
Or maybe the purple wall is a "portal" for white-core objects. Let me try pushing right.
